name: Core Scientific, Inc.
blurb: Core Scientific, Inc. provides high-density colocation services and digital asset mining infrastructure in the United States. The company operates through three segments: Colocation, Digital Asset Self-Mining, and Digital Asset Hosted Mining. It offers space, power, cooling, and security services for machine learning and AI workloads, as well as deployment and maintenance of digital asset mining equipment. Core Scientific is a leading player in the Bitcoin mining and AI infrastructure space.
recent: In the past 30 days, Core Scientific reported earnings on May 6, 2026. The stock has seen significant volatility, with a 52-week range of $9.77 to $25.17, and a market cap of $7.70 billion. The company continues to benefit from the growing demand for AI and cryptocurrency mining infrastructure.
